# GENERATED 2026-08-31 by hand with `mk` 0.13.0 on PATH, P1 cycle (NOT part
# of P0's fixture set). Key material: crates/md-cli/tests/fixtures/pathological/keys.txt
# (KEY n = its n-th record, 1-based). Policy: reuses v-bound-seat.txt's OWN
# md1 line verbatim (its policy declares BOTH slots at the SAME bare path
# m/48'/0'/0'/2', no fingerprint -- the shape row 1 needs).
#
#   mk encode --xpub <KEY 1> --origin-fingerprint 73c5da0a \
#     --origin-path m/48'/0'/0'/2' --policy-id-stub 5b48af35 --chunk-set-id 0xA1099
#   mk encode --xpub <KEY 5> --origin-fingerprint b8688df1 \
#     --origin-path m/48'/0'/0'/2' --policy-id-stub 5b48af35 --chunk-set-id 0xA1099
#
# WHY THIS FIXTURE EXISTS (P1 finding, not a P0 defect in the ENGINE):
# `v-ap-canonical.txt` + `v-ap-canonical-control.txt` (P0's own row-1
# fixtures) cannot reach a seating AT ALL, pinned OR unpinned: BOTH of that
# pair's two cards were minted with `--origin-fingerprint <KEY N's fp>`,
# and EVERY key in keys.txt records the SAME shared fingerprint (73c5da0a)
# -- so both cards declare the IDENTICAL (fingerprint, path), which
# `satisfy::check_no_impossible_card_pair` refuses UNCONDITIONALLY (an
# ORTHOGONAL, pre-existing check -- "two cards claiming the identical
# (fingerprint, path) with DIFFERENT xpubs... impossible from one master").
# Measured directly: `md descriptor` on EITHER v-ap-canonical.txt OR its
# control refuses with that exact message, confirming the control was
# ALSO never seatable -- this is not something P1 changed or can fix by
# adjusting the engine (SPEC §2 has no case here; the refusal fires before
# the engine's own group-id-scoped stage is even reached, on the CARD-SET
# check that runs ahead of A2/A3 for every seating, collided or not).
#
# THIS fixture sidesteps it exactly the way v-bound-seat.txt already does
# for the SAME two-slot-one-path shape: explicit, DISTINCT fingerprints per
# card (73c5da0a / b8688df1, not the shared per-key default), which is
# philosophically closer to "two real different masters" anyway. The
# UNPINNED CONTROL for this fixture is `v-bound-seat.txt` itself (same two
# keys, same fingerprints, same path, same stub -- natural, non-colliding
# ids 69f0e/decb1 instead of a pinned a1099); the P1 e2e row-1 test compares
# THIS pinned pair's seating against THAT already-committed control.
